name: Still Has Value sales tracker
notes: Grok/voice should set source to grok-voice. Do not invent a sale price. Costs: purchaseCost (acquisition), storageCost, cleaningCost, repairCost (materials). Optional inventoryId is the shop item id from inventory.json. After a confirmed tracker save, the tracker (not the shop page) marks that item status sold in inventory.json so it drops off the shop. If Grok/voice has no inventoryId, the tracker matches by title; if two or more match, it skips the shop update. If the Sheet save succeeds but mark-sold fails, the tracker returns partialSuccess with an actionable shopError.
sheet: Still Has Value Tracker, Sales tab

source.description: Use grok-voice when an AI logs it

inventoryId.description: Shop inventory.json item id for the live listing. Prefer picking it on the tracker form so Save marks that listing sold.
